proposal_metadata.title: Five-W communication instrumentation and topology analysis
proposal_metadata.author: claude_cowork_opus5
proposal_metadata.rationale: Five-W message records are the measurement substrate the other emergent-behaviour experiments depend on, not a parallel hypothesis. Complete records of sanctioned channels are also what make emergent_hidden_coordination_channels testable in principle, via the gap between observed coordination and logged messages.
derived_from: docs/graph_state_2026-09.md (experiment 3 and the dependency structure of experiments 1-5)
architecture/foundations.md (named artifact on every dependency edge)
proposal_metadata.verification_plan: Instrument all sanctioned messages; require >=98% field coverage at <5% token overhead and demonstrate that topology analysis recovers explicitly assigned roles in a control condition before using it to detect emergent ones.

add_nodes.label: Five-W message instrumentation (who, what, when, why, which channel)
add_nodes.description: Every inter-agent message carries sender/receiver, content class from a versioned taxonomy, timestamp, declared purpose captured at the sending call site, and channel identifier. Declared purpose is a claim about intent and is analysed as such, never as evidence of function.

add_nodes.label: Communication topology verification suite
add_nodes.description: Analysis layer over Five-W records: topology density and centralization, per-agent message-class distributions, timing patterns, and the sanctioned-vs-observed coordination gap. Gated by a control condition: it must recover explicitly assigned roles before being trusted to detect emergent ones.

add_edges.description: Makes the coordination structure of any orchestration pattern observable rather than assumed.

Complete records of sanctioned channels make unsanctioned coordination detectable as outcome dependency with no corresponding message path. Evidence of unexplained coordination, never proof of its absence.
Concrete instance of the append-only audit surface the control-plane concept already claims as a subnode.
